title: Salmon with fennel and orange
summary: Salmon with fennel and orange is a mediterranean dinner built around salmon fillets and fennel, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Salmon with fennel and orange into even pieces and toss fennel with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of fennel while you season salmon fillets. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle salmon fillets and oranges among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Salmon with fennel and orange before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Salmon with fennel and orange into warm bowls with the juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
